W1: A cyber breach of a control center

Q: What is the maximum statutory penalty FERC and NERC can levy per day per violation?
A: Statutorily capped and adjusted annually for inflation; verify the current FERC-adjusted maximum

Q: What is a NERC Alert?
A: An advisory or directive issued by NERC regarding urgent reliability or cybersecurity threats
W1: A legal filing with FERC regarding a violation
W2: A public press release about a grid outage
W3: A mandatory training requirement for all employees

Q: Which level of NERC Alert requires a mandatory response from registered entities?
A: Level 3 (Essential Action) alerts require registered entities to respond to NERC on implementation status; Level 2 (Recommendation) alerts are recommendations not mandatory

Q: What is a Self-Report in NERC compliance?
A: A voluntary notification to the Regional Entity disclosing a potential non-compliance
W1: A mandatory filing required only after a FERC audit
W2: A public press release about a cyber incident
W3: A request for a penalty reduction after a violation is discovered

Q: Why is submitting a timely Self-Report beneficial?
A: It is treated as a mitigating factor and can significantly reduce or eliminate financial penalties
W1: It automatically eliminates all penalties regardless of severity
W2: It exempts the entity from future audits
W3: It transfers liability to the vendor

Q: What is a Mitigation Plan?
A: A formal action plan detailing how an entity will correct a non-compliance and prevent recurrence
W1: A plan to mitigate physical damage from storms
W2: A plan to reduce insurance premiums
W3: A plan to avoid NERC audits

Q: What is the CMECP?
A: Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement Program
W1: Critical Monitoring and Enforcement Compliance Protocol
W2: Compliance Management and Enforcement Certification Program
W3: Cyber Monitoring and Enforcement Compliance Plan

Q: What is an RSAW?
A: Reliability Standard Audit Worksheet

Q: What is a Compliance Exception (CE)?
A: A streamlined disposition method for minimal-risk non-compliance issues
W1: A permanent exemption from a NERC standard
W2: A finding that results in an automatic monetary penalty
W3: A request to extend a mitigation plan deadline

Q: What is a Find Fix Track and Report (FFT)?
A: An enforcement mechanism for moderate-to-minimal risk non-compliances that have already been remediated
W1: A program for finding and fixing physical equipment failures
W2: A NERC audit process for high-risk violations only
W3: A reporting requirement for cyber incidents only

Q: What is a Notice of Penalty (NOP)?
A: A formal enforcement filing with FERC when a violation warrants a monetary penalty or formal sanction
W1: A notice that a penalty has been waived
W2: A public announcement of a compliance achievement
W3: A notification that an entity has been deregistered

Q: What is an Inherent Risk Assessment (IRA)?
A: An evaluation to determine an entity's specific reliability risks based on its assets footprint and operational profile
W1: An internal audit by the entity's compliance team
W2: A FERC assessment of wholesale rate fairness
W3: A NERC assessment of cyber insurance coverage

Q: What is the 15-minute rule in NERC CIP?
A: The threshold used in CIP-002 to determine if a cyber asset's compromise would adversely impact the reliable operation of the BES within 15 minutes
W1: The maximum time allowed to report a cyber incident
W2: The minimum duration a cyber asset must be offline before reclassification
W3: The window during which a patch must be installed after evaluation

Q: What is an Intermediate System under CIP-005 used for?
A: Mediating Interactive Remote Access so remote users do not connect directly to a BES Cyber System inside an ESP
W1: Storing BES Cyber System Information for backup
W2: Monitoring physical access to an ESP
W3: Routing SCADA telemetry between control centers

Q: What is Transient Cyber Asset (TCA) management under CIP-010?
A: Security controls applied to portable devices temporarily connected to BES Cyber Systems
W1: Security controls applied to permanently installed substation relays
W2: Security controls applied to vendor-owned cloud infrastructure
W3: Security controls applied to backup generators at control centers

Q: What is the CIP Senior Manager delegation rule?
A: Delegations must be documented in writing and the CIP Senior Manager retains overall accountability
W1: Authority cannot be delegated under any circumstances
W2: Authority may be delegated verbally with no documentation
W3: Authority may only be delegated to another corporate officer

Q: What is BCSI?
A: BES Cyber System Information

A: CIP-009

A: CIP-012

A: CIP-014

Q: What is a Reportable Cyber Security Incident?
A: An incident that has caused or attempted to compromise a BES Cyber System
W1: Any cybersecurity event including minor scans
W2: Only incidents resulting in physical damage

Q: What is the purpose of a vulnerability assessment under CIP-010?
A: To identify and remediate cyber vulnerabilities in BES Cyber Systems
W1: To assess physical security of substations

Q: What must be documented for a configuration change under CIP-010?
A: The change and its impact on existing cybersecurity controls
W1: Only the date of the change

Q: What is the CIP-007 requirement for malicious code prevention?
A: Deploy antivirus or other malicious code prevention with updates

Q: What is the CIP-007 requirement for ports and services?
A: Enable only necessary ports and services and document the reason
W2: Disable all ports at all times

Q: What is the CIP-007 requirement for security event logging?
A: Log security events and retain logs for at least 90 days
W2: Retain logs for at least 30 days

Q: What is a BES Cyber Asset?
A: A cyber asset that if rendered unavailable degraded or misused would within 15 minutes adversely impact the BES
W1: Any computer connected to the internet

Q: What is an Electronic Security Perimeter?
A: The logical border surrounding a network to which BES Cyber Systems are connected
W1: A physical fence around a substation

Q: What is a Protected Cyber Asset?
A: A cyber asset within an ESP that is not a BES Cyber System
W1: A cyber asset outside the ESP

Q: What is the purpose of CIP-012?
A: To protect the confidentiality and integrity of Real-time Assessment and Real-time monitoring data transmitted between control centers
W1: To protect physical security of substations

Q: What is the purpose of CIP-013?
A: To mitigate cyber security risks in the supply chain for BES Cyber Systems
W1: To protect physical security of substations

Q: What is a Reportable Cyber Security Incident timeframe for attempted compromise?
A: By the end of the next calendar day after determination

Q: What is the CIP-008 requirement for incident response plans?
A: Documented plans that include roles responsibilities and procedures
W3: Plans only for High Impact systems

Q: What is the CIP-009 requirement for recovery plans?
A: Documented plans that include roles responsibilities and procedures
W3: Plans only for High Impact systems

Q: What is the CIP-010 requirement for baseline configuration?
A: Documented baseline configurations for BES Cyber Systems
W3: Baselines only for High Impact systems

Q: What is the CIP-010 requirement for vulnerability assessments?
A: Conduct vulnerability assessments at least every 15 months for High and Medium Impact
W1: Conduct assessments only after an incident

Q: What is the CIP-004 requirement for access management?
A: Authorize and verify access based on need-to-know and least privilege

Q: What is the CIP-005 requirement for remote access?
A: Require encryption MFA and intermediate systems for Interactive Remote Access
W1: Allow direct remote access without encryption
W2: Allow remote access with password-only authentication

Q: What is the CIP-006 requirement for physical access?
A: Control and monitor physical access to BES Cyber Systems
W3: No physical access controls are required

Q: What is the CIP-007 requirement for system hardening?
A: Disable unnecessary ports and services and document the reason
W2: Disable all ports at all times

Q: What is the CIP-011 requirement for BCSI?
A: Protect BES Cyber System Information from unauthorized access
W1: Share BCSI freely with all employees

Q: What is the CIP-013 requirement for supply chain risk management?
A: Develop and implement a supply chain cyber security risk management plan
W1: Conduct only financial audits of vendors
W2: No supply chain management is required
W3: Delegate all supply chain risk to vendors
